name: 81506 · Grand Jct, CO
findings: ZIP 81506 (Grand Jct) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81506 (Grand Jct) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81506 (Grand Jct) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
